set system host-name CE3.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 172.16.1.1/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set protocols bgp group external.explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

neighbor 172.16.1.2.explanation: Configure the neighbors of the BGP team.

family inet unicast.explanation: Configure the addresses of the BGP neighbors.

parameters.name: address-family
parameters.explanation: Addresses of BGP neighbours, e.g. not unicast.

set policy-options policy-statement expo.explanation: This command fragment defines a routing policy named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing you to configure specific routing rules, actions, and conditions for traffic control.

term 1.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing policy by defining a term within a policy statement, where `[parameter1]` is the policy name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.

then accept.explanation: Configure the action of the policy statement as accepted.
